description: Verify a SwapEazi Release Record v1, the evidence of a managed payment (or a chain of them), with no key: schema (https://swapeazi.io/schemas/release-record-v1.json), hash, chain link and Ed25519 signature against the published key. Returns valid or invalid with each test named and the first record that breaks. Nothing sent is stored. The same verification runs offline from the spec at https://swapeazi.io/standard.

chain.description: Optional. The records around it, in any order; links are verified in seq order.

record.description: One release record, as returned by record_release, release_status or GET /api/v1/releases/{id}.

name: verify_release_record
title: Verify a release record
